name: ledgerly
description: Ledgerly — freelancer finance OS (Angular + NestJS + Neon + Tailwind)

scripts.dev: node tools/node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n api,web -c teal,cyan "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run start --prefix apps/web -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --proxy-config proxy.conf.json"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm run build --prefix apps/api
